checkpoints.name: held_in_reset
checkpoints.description: Reset is still asserted; count is parked at zero.

checkpoints.name: post_reset_zero
checkpoints.description: Reset released at t=22 ns. The next posedge (t=30) is what increments the counter, so at t=25 it is still parked at zero with the reset released.

checkpoints.name: first_increment
checkpoints.description: First clock posedge with reset deasserted and enable high (t=30) increments count to 1.

checkpoints.name: mid_range
checkpoints.description: Counter has been incrementing for ~1.3 microseconds and reads 0x80.

checkpoints.name: pre_rollover
checkpoints.description: Counter is parked at 0xFF for one cycle; overflow strobe is high.

checkpoints.name: post_rollover
checkpoints.description: Counter has rolled over to 0x00; overflow strobe has fallen.
